river_coords <- read_csv("~/FishyG/data/survey_sites_vancouver_isl.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

tmax <- rast("~/FishyG/data/Global_weather/t_max_monthly_1960_2025.nc", subds = "t_max")

pr <- rast("~/FishyG/data/Global_weather/monthly_prcp_1960_2025.nc", subds = "pr")

tmax_s <- disagg(tmax, fact = 8, method = "bilinear")

```{r}
river_coords <- river_coords %>%
  mutate(model = case_when(
    stream_name_pse %in% c("NANAIMO RIVER", "COWICHAN RIVER", "LITTLE QUALICUM RIVER", "CHEMAINUS RIVER") ~ "Model", TRUE ~"No model"
  ))

pal <- colorFactor("Dark2", domain = river_coords$model)
```

```{r}
tm_pr <- time(pr)

pr_years  <- as.integer(format(tm_pr, "%Y"))
pr_months <- as.integer(format(tm_pr, "%m"))

pal_p <- colorQuantile("Blues", values(pr), n = 7, na.color = "transparent")

```

```{r}
pal_t <- colorBin("RdYlBu", domain = values(tmax), bins = 8,
                  na.color = "transparent", reverse = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ============ UI ============

ui <- fluidPage(
  fluidRow(
    column(5,
      h4("Site Map"),
      checkboxGroupInput("model", "Model:",
                         choices = sort(unique(river_coords$model)),
                         selected = unique(river_coords$model)),
      radioButtons("layer", "Climate layer:",
                   choices = c("None" = "none",
                               "Mean precipitation" = "pr",
                               "Max temperature" = "tmax"),
                   selected = "pr"),
      sliderInput("idx", "Month:", min = 1, max = length(tm_pr),
                  value = length(tm_pr), step = 1, width = "100%",
                  animate = animationOptions(interval = 1200, loop = TRUE)),
      strong(textOutput("month_label", inline = TRUE)),
      hr(),
      h4(textOutput("site_name")),
      plotOutput("site_plot", height = 800)
    ),
    column(7,
      leafletOutput("map", height = 750)
    )
  )
)


# ============ SERVER ============

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  selected_site <- reactiveVal(NULL)

  observeEvent(input$map_marker_click, {
    selected_site(input$map_marker_click$id)
  })

  filtered <- reactive({
    river_coords[river_coords$model %in% input$model, ]
  })

  output$month_label <- renderText(format(tm_pr[input$idx], "%B %Y"))

  output$site_name <- renderText({
    if (is.null(selected_site())) "Click a site" else selected_site()
  })

  # ---- base map ----
    output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>%
      addTiles(group = "Street") %>%
      fitBounds(min(river_coords$longitude), min(river_coords$latitude),
                max(river_coords$longitude), max(river_coords$latitude)) %>%
      addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("Street", "Satellite"),
                       options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE))
  })
    session$onFlushed(function() {
  leafletProxy("map") %>%
    fitBounds(min(river_coords$longitude), min(river_coords$latitude),
              max(river_coords$longitude), max(river_coords$latitude))
}, once = TRUE)
  

  # ---- climate raster ----
  observe({
    leafletProxy("map") %>% clearGroup("Climate")
    req(input$layer != "none")

    idx <- input$idx
    req(!is.null(idx))

    if (input$layer == "pr") {
      r <- pr_s[[idx]];   p <- pal_p; stack_vals <- values(pr);   unit <- "mm/month"
    } else {
      r <- tmax_s[[idx]]; p <- pal_t; stack_vals <- values(tmax); unit <- "\u00B0C"
    }

    leafletProxy("map") %>%
      addRasterImage(r, colors = p, opacity = 0.85,
                     group = "Climate", project = FALSE, method = "bilinear") %>%
      addLegend("bottomright", pal = p, values = stack_vals,
                layerId = "climate_legend",
                title = paste0(format(tm_pr[idx], "%B %Y"), "<br>(", unit, ")"))
  })

  # ---- site markers, redrawn after the raster so they stay on top ----
  observe({
    req(nrow(filtered()) > 0)
    leafletProxy("map", data = filtered()) %>%
      clearGroup("Sites") %>%
      addCircleMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude,
                       group = "Sites",
                       layerId = ~stream_name_pse,
                       fillColor = ~pal(model),
                       fillOpacity = 0.9, stroke = FALSE, radius = 6,
                       label = ~stream_name_pse,
                       popup = ~paste0("<b>", stream_name_pse,
                                       "</b><br>Model: ", model))
  })

  # ---- highlight ring on the clicked site ----
  observeEvent(input$map_marker_click, {
    click <- input$map_marker_click
    leafletProxy("map") %>%
      clearGroup("selected") %>%
      addCircleMarkers(lng = click$lng, lat = click$lat, group = "selected",
                       radius = 11, color = "black", weight = 3,
                       fillOpacity = 0)
  })

  # ---- saved plot for the clicked site ----
  output$site_plot <- renderPlot({
  req(selected_site())
  p <- plot_list[[selected_site()]]
  validate(need(!is.null(p), "No plot for this site"))
  p
}, res = 96)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
